Overview

Helsingborg is a city in Skåne with a population of 113,000. A coastal city at the narrowest point of the Øresund, with a historic fortress and ferry connections to Denmark. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
